report: Reassessed both requirements: declared calls need not occur, and their execution order is independent of clause order. Captured parse/valid fixture helpers; assertions are visible in the associated test and assert_calls_conform implementation. No TODO/N/A entries or prerequisites exist. This is source inspection plus historical byte comparison, not new behavioral execution. I ran review start/read and comparison commands; the coordinator separately reports 321 functional tests and cargo build passing. No source edits or additional test runs were needed.
